scope: Init-only nominal 32768 Hz LSE SYSCLK on exactly CW32L012C8T6 and CW32L012C8U6, using Config.lse and the native L012 admission. Generic L012 and other package selections are excluded. Own-L012 source qualification only; no runtime or hardware validation.
hardware_count_source: Own CN RM PDF62/printed36 and EN RM PDF66/printed40: fewer than 128 LSE edges in 256 LSI cycles detects running failure when LSECCS is enabled.
margin_source: Separate software margin: minimum_LSE_hz * 256 > 129 * 36080; smallest integral minimum is 18181 Hz. The extra edge is not the hardware threshold or measured cycle timing.

native_lsi_reference.basis: Own DS PDF58/printed55 gives factory 32.8kHz +/-10% over -40..85 C, hence 29520..36080 Hz. Own CN RM PDF59/printed33 separately describes legal +/-10%; approximate 0.4% trim-step and 30-36kHz prose differ from DS 0.16%. Factory match and STABLE do not measure live frequency or cycle timing.

fallback.basis: Own CN RM PDF62/printed36 and EN RM PDF66/printed40 plus CR1 CLKCCS EN75/49 document effective HSI4MHz fallback when enabled. Factory 96MHz +/-2% and /24 yield 3.92-4.08MHz. Software admits full4.08MHz without bus-divider credit even when CLKCCS=0. No fault-time register retention or divider reset is claimed.

transition_policy: Raise authoritative FLASH.WAIT to3 after original full CR2 and WAIT-alias agreement. Every owned readback validates faults and phase-derived immutable policy/source identity before accepting new/new, bounded old/old waiting, or rejecting all other pairs. Install final divisors and fallback-safe final WAIT under calibrated HSI before the last LSE CR0 write. No CR0 or FLASH write follows final selection. Preserve the single accepted pre-start Admission refresh and publish only after all final checks.
cold_lsi_admission: Latch temporary-LSI-needed && !entry-LSI.STABLE from original entry. Temporary need includes trim bridge, retained HSECCS/LSECCS, and enabled LSI-selected LVD or VC1..4 regardless filter count. Before first oscillator change and again before first request reject RTC SOURCE2/reserved, UART1/2 SOURCE3, operational UART3 SOURCE3, I2C1/2 master/slave raw1/3, enabled LPTIM ICLKSRC3 regardless mode, MCO4, LSIRDY, and enabled LSI filters. Every needed LSIEN assertion has an adjacent full original-policy/source/fault commit check, including entry-already-stable cases. Restore each gate independently; restoration failure wins. Closed disputed UART3 and uninspected observers require explicit functional handover.
hsi_ownership: RTC SOURCE3 owns raw HSIOSC even with START0 and requires enabled, stable, factory-matching HSI. Start/restart/retrim or initially-unready wait rejects MCO3, HSIRDY and I2C1/2 master/slave raw1/3. Factory-ready DIV-only changes preserve raw HSIOSC. External HSIOSC output and other uninspected observers require functional handover.
auxiliary_projection: Remove only sysclk_detector. All prior native_low_power auxiliary facts and own proof bytes remain unchanged.
limits: StartupOnly loss can stop the CPU with STABLE latched and no returned error; poll budgets count CPU iterations only while execution continues.
ADC work-gate and whole-GPIOC windows can advance functional work before refusal; restoration cannot undo it. Existing bus-master/memory ownership and explicit functional handover remain required.
Fault routes may affect IRQs, captures, brakes and PWM before error; no flags are cleared.
No fault-time register retention, execution-progress, bounded fallback time, RTC continuity, rollback or recovery guarantee.
No LSI TRIM/WAIT writes, runtime retuning, RTC migration, wake/resume, silicon validation or 1MHz time-driver support.

sdk_corroboration.authority_limit: Own original field/selector corroboration only. SDK enum/comment conflicts do not resolve manual disputes. No broad SDK writes or erased-trim replacement values are imported.

source_conflicts: RM LSE bypass1MHz is not adopted over DS100kHz.
RCC WAIT4 narrative does not widen the qualified96MHz envelope or Flash WAIT0..3 table.
UART3 gate: CN configuration-only versus EN configuration-and-work; do not open a closed gate.
I2C master source3: EN HSI versus SDK LSI; slave source3 EN LSI. Raw1/3 are conservatively refused without resolving the conflict.

BTIM native raw0 no signal and instance-specific raw3 BTIM1 RTC_OUT, BTIM2 LPTIM_OV, BTIM3 VC4_OUT versus SDK AWT0/RTC6; native SPI5/UART6 versus SDK SPI3/UART5; native reset4 I2Cx_TRGO versus SDK I2C_SCL. No positive timer absence proof uses either disputed table.
ATIM native TI2/TI5 RTC6 versus generic/SDK8; generic LSI9/MCO15 and native tables are not interchangeable absence proofs.
LPTIM block trigger5 PC13 versus native table RTC_1Hz; conservatively preserve all1..5 RTC dependencies.
PINLOCK fault behavior remains unresolved; never clear or adopt raw PINLOCK.
LSI approximate0.4% and30-36kHz prose does not replace DS0.16% steps or its factory +/-10% envelope.
Stray SDK PLL parameter comment conflicts with the own four-source selector set; no PLL is qualified.
entry_contract: Unchanged LSI and the active incoming clocks/latency must already be electrically legal. StartupOnly does not require factory LSI. Entry monitored readiness is immutable and later bridge startup cannot qualify it. A failure consumes initialization ownership and requires reset before retry; ordinary reset may retain LSE.

consumer_policy.lvd: ungated; EN and FLTCLK0 request LSI without filter-count condition
